neighbours.label: ' water' as the first word of a compound noun naming a thing (water gun, water beetle), not water as a substance
fire: My little brother sprayed me with his new water pistol.
We spotted a large water snake near the river bank.
The plumber replaced the old water heater in the basement.
Kids lined up at the park for the water slide.
A water buffalo pulled the cart through the muddy field.
The hikers refilled their water bottles at the spring.
Scientists found a rare water lily in the swamp.
Pond surfaces are home to the tiny water strider.
quiet: My little brother sprayed me with cold water from the hose.
We spotted a large snake swimming in the water near the bank.
The plumber said the basement was full of water.
Kids lined up at the park to splash in the water.
The buffalo pulled the cart through mud and water.
The hikers drank fresh water at the spring.
Scientists found a rare lily floating on the water.
Tiny insects skate across the surface of the water.

notes: The card also shows ' bl'(aster) and 'Jar' in game guides; not tested here.
